qa_pairs.instruction: What is the purpose of auditing in the Bi Impl Mid I driver?
qa_pairs.output: Auditing in the Bi Impl Mid I driver is used to track changes to sensitive information and to provide a record that can be examined periodically for security and compliance purposes.

qa_pairs.instruction: How do you monitor driver operation with NetIQ Audit for the Bi Impl Mid I driver?
qa_pairs.output: To monitor driver operation with NetIQ Audit for the Bi Impl Mid I driver, refer to the NetIQ Audit Documentation website at http://www.novell.com/documentation/novellaudit20/index.html, which provides detailed instructions on configuring and using NetIQ Audit to capture driver activity.

qa_pairs.instruction: Summarize the auditing guidance for the Bi Impl Mid I driver.
qa_pairs.output: The Bi Impl Mid I driver recommends tracking changes to sensitive information through audit logs and reviewing those logs periodically. Detailed guidance on using NetIQ Audit for this purpose is available in the NetIQ Audit Documentation website.
